status: fixed-source reviewed; hosted and full release acceptance remain open

review.source: Inspected migration/startup explicit version check and recursive PostgreSQL role query against PostgreSQL17 USAGE/SET and ADMIN OPTION authority semantics. Schema, relation and function owners are checked. Elevated attributes require assumable authority; non-assumable attribute-only membership is not treated as owner or superuser. No unresolved confirmed issue found in this scoped fixed-source review.
review.evidence: Matched all three committed implementation files to tested overlay and verified canonical fixed snapshot digest, 65 evidence file hashes and three review input hashes. Original three negative regressions are retained.
review.reason: Frozen evidence is intact and the scoped source review found no new change or unresolved concern requiring repeat execution.

limitations: Only local PostgreSQL17.11 execution is qualified by the implementer receipt.
No hosted authentication/TLS, operational backup/failover, production deployment, independent external security audit or GA acceptance.
Startup guards assume an administrator does not subsequently grant new unsafe authority; operational permission monitoring remains open.
